query:
INSERT INTO conversations (agencyId, leadId, channel, contactName, contactPhone, contactEmail, lastMessageAt, lastMessagePreview, isRead, isArchived, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  la.agencyId,
  la.leadId,
  la.type AS channel,
  CONCAT(COALESCE(l.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(l.last_name, '')) AS contactName,
  CASE WHEN la.type = 'sms' THEN l.phone ELSE NULL END AS contactPhone,
  CASE WHEN la.type = 'email' THEN l.email ELSE NULL END AS contactEmail,
  la.createdAt AS lastMessageAt,
  LEFT(la.content, 200) AS lastMessagePreview,
  1 AS isRead,
  0 AS isArchived,
  la.createdAt AS createdAt,
  la.createdAt AS updatedAt
FROM lead_activities la
LEFT JOIN leads l ON la.leadId = l.id
WHERE la.type IN ('sms', 'email') AND la.userId IS NOT NULL;
